If I didn't love my baby so much I'd return this thing immediately. It should not have been nearly as difficult to put together as it was. The positioning of how everything was was awful. Aside from that once finally put together kid has been wheeling it around whenever he gets the chance and convincing us to pull him around in it. Has also come in handy to wheel around a few bags of sand that were just too heavy to carry from front yard to back yard without assistance. If it were up to me I'd buy one preassembled next go around to avoid so much frustration.
